title: ResponseMetaV1
description: Metadata attached to every successful Core API and Agent Runtime response. NOTE: this reflects the implemented shape, which differs from document 10 section 4.2 — see contracts/DIVERGENCE.md.

correlation_id.description: Request correlation id. Taken from the x-correlation-id request header when present, otherwise generated as a UUID v4. Echoed back in the x-correlation-id response header.

timestamp.description: Server time when the response was built, ISO 8601 UTC.
